calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT m.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members
FROM active a
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT m.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS active_members_no_exclusions, count(*) 
FROM active a
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
